title: [Master]- Service Item does not populate Ship-to Country/Region Code when Ship-to Code is blank
summary: Service Item Card now populates Ship-to Country/Region Code from the customer's default location when no specific Ship-to Code is selected.
key_points: Service Item Card page modified to handle blank Ship-to Code scenarios
Ship-to Country/Region Code now derives from customer's default shipping location
Fixes behavior where country/region code was not populated in certain cases
Test coverage added to verify the fix
